title: Policy and Legal Effect own decision rules; fixtures are not regulation
summary: Currency, booking entity, customer domicile/residence, product, channel and transaction corridor are decision facts. Institutional Policy owns corporate limits, fee/waiver, reservation and account-opening rules; Legal Effect is selected/evaluated separately. Supplied numeric/legal values are fixtures only.
invariants: Do not put transaction limits or fee rules into account/customer numeric fields.
Do not infer one universal legal profile merely from the account currency label.
For cross-currency FX, both source and target Legal Effects are evaluated.
All numeric limits, credit bands, legal norms, FX rates/markups and similar package defaults are test fixtures unless an authoritative policy source says otherwise.
Policy provenance belongs with durable transaction evidence.

provenance.claim: Regulatory/corporate routing uses decision facts and test fixtures are not real regulation.
